items.title: Limits and colimits of abelian sheaves on a site, and exactness of filtered colimits

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes five facts about limits and colimits in the category of abelian sheaves on a site: existence of all limits and colimits, agreement of limits with presheaf limits, agreement of finite direct sums with the presheaf ones, the description of colimits as sheafified presheaf colimits, and exactness of filtered colimits. Limits are handled by taking the presheaf limit and using that it is already a sheaf, whence it is also the sheaf-theoretic limit; colimits are handled by adjointness of sheafification with the inclusion, which identifies the colimit as a sheafified presheaf colimit and gives exactness of filtered colimits (proof lines 438-474). H2: the two identifications through the sheaf condition and through adjointness are the substance, and the argument is written out rather than cited wholesale.
